name: How to Save Our Beach (formerly Sand School)
integration: Existing app imported as a separate learning section within the Hamilton Beach research map. Exported preview-edit helper removed; simulations and source links retained.
angle_review: 2026-10-17: replaced shared shoreline-normal drawing with separate image-bearing estimates: existing A approximately 160 degrees, C1 approximately 158 degrees, C2 approximately 169 degrees, clockwise from image north. Controls allow orientation sensitivity checks. Historical endpoints visually digitized; modern crop registration does not validate historical georeferencing.
limitation: Illustrative educational models, not a surveyed shoreline forecast, approved engineering design or determination of property rights. Angles are photo/plan estimates, not transcribed survey bearings. Cross-shore projection is a heuristic, not a calibrated angle-specific hydrodynamic model. No measured placement or angular error bound.
